instruction: Place an amazon order as per my wife's email today.
notes: The wife is identified via phone.search_contacts(relationship="wife"), which also yields her email (used as from_email together with today's date to locate the thread in gmail) and her work address text. gmail.show_thread exposes the email body, from which the requested product type and price cap are read (requirements-known). amazon.search_products with product_type, max_price and sort_by=-rating selects the highest-rated affordable product; it is added to the cart with quantity=1 and clear_cart_first=true so the resulting order contains exactly one item of quantity one. The wife's work address is added as a NEW amazon address (existing addresses are never updated/deleted) and the order is placed with the supervisor's amazon payment card. Single objects for datetime, sort key, quantity and flag keep the model minimal. If the email spells out the delivery address or the exact product-type string, those values bind from gmail.show_thread instead (amazon.search_product_types can be used to resolve the exact type name); if sort_by=-rating is unsupported, the agent scans all result pages for the highest rating. supervisor.complete_task carries no answer (record parameters only).
